mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing water crossing lipid alone with crossing through aquaporin was most worthwhile: the matched conditions show that the channel speeds exchange without determining its net direction.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the sodium channel was straightforward and somewhat repetitive after installing aquaporin, though it prepared a useful comparison.

surprise.text: The lipid-only membrane allowed slow water exchange in both directions; the comparison clarified that net movement and individual molecules' movement are different things.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each construction had a visible connection to a transport goal.

continue.text: I would continue to another chapter: the matched membrane comparisons made the physiology concrete, and I would be curious to see how later constructions connect it to cells and organs.
